applies_why: The judge resolves a collision between a footed challenger chain and the link by invoking the challenged sentence's own words, which is the thing K-C governs.
quote: but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: by footing, never verse by verse — I weighed whether the judge weighed chain against chain by footing or instead used the challenged sentence's own words as a verse-level stating test.
why: The judge lets Matthew 1:20's own wording override the challenger's footed analogy, which applies a verse-level stating test instead of chain-against-chain footing.
